checks.finding: The full original BaseChangeIsobaricN, polarized RowT/PropsB attachment, local correspondence/classification and tied period inputs remain expressly named. BCS and GUA prove their complete consumers, not these foundational theorems themselves. The existing integral TypeForAlt retains its every-IsRecT and every-Teichmuller-family scope and its already identified local type foundations.

LTP preserves actual right translations, scalarization, coefficient matrices, dual infinity weights, all natural spherical indices, depth-one Kc(1), and one simultaneous family of actual local components. GUA retains arbitrary original ranks, prime 3, fixed iota, every permitted correspondence and bridge, original local guards, and all positive Speh lengths until the stated irreducibility branch. The narrative does not infer unrestricted purity or length one.

UPA14-17 fill the literal PartAltAlt/UnitaryPointProperties/AutomorphicHeckeSet supplier rather than assuming that compact decomposition already provides Galois data. UPA18 supplies the exact hAut input of AFS22 and proves bare TJDense under original HypothesesH-prime/IsJ, including the same-kernel nonzero branch and J=B zero branch. No replacement radical or support ideal is introduced.

HEP10-12 supply one continuous semisimple representation, its point properties and full determinant law at every admitted arithmetic point. Ordered flags and every-bridge potential crystallinity are asserted only under the original Good condition on that same point. The final config, common metadata, TXT audit and generated TeX make this guard explicit.

HEP2 performs its Newton divisions only after evaluation in characteristic-zero Qbar_ell, not in the original coefficient ring. JRP records descent of full polynomial laws and universal scalar-algebra kernel conditions, not merely equality on group elements. Prime 3 and the original nonflat/CNL coefficient scope are not excluded.

JRP14 handles the zero quotient directly. JRP15 keeps the original f, T, Lambda and J=ker(f), uses jointly separating good zero-weight Hecke points, and retains V0ok exactly for auxiliary-place unramifiedness. All eight RingProps fields are identified; no later arithmetic-classicality or purity output is inferred from the ring argument.

The source HidaPropsAlt record has ring, dense, pt, end1, end2 and twist. The current assembly closes only ring and dense at this layer. PointTheoremBaseObject, ArithmeticPointDecomposition with its cofinite strict Frobenius-norm ratio, IrrArithPointsAutomorphicAway and TwistOk remain explicit. The earlier OrdCoreH.Out.pt is correctly distinguished from the later PointTheoremBaseObject.

Full HidaPropsAlt/ModularAlt and all-level same-J LevelAlt/TWAut/HasAut on both original rank-four Links remain open. Fixed iota, prime 3, complete CohP/LocCFT, one common coefficient threshold, original universal B/Lambda, metrics, lattices and measures are retained. No arbitrary-Kap or arbitrary-chain strengthening is claimed.

The selected finite local WeightAllRows theorem remains conditional on its original normalized-type and common-row inputs, with the eventual rank guard for its last term. EtOne/reduction/inflation/Haar data, RowsAdd/RowsGood, one common AllRows, arithmetic cylinder counts and global estimates remain open. Its local completion is not promoted to the whole GLOBAL_RETAINED_DEFECT contract.

All 31 predecessor whole-obligation IDs, categories, statuses and requires lists are unchanged. The sole changed whole-contract text is COUNT_II_SUPPORT internal progress; its original outer quantified contract and closing precision restrictions are preserved. There are 22 C and 9 B obligations, 24 shared and 7 additional for Dirichlet GRH, with zero new whole-leaf closures.

All 31 exact contract texts occur in the generated TXT audit. The new and cumulative manuscripts retain the same audited current narrative, 119 new/2560 cumulative claims, and the 121-node/161-edge selected graph.
